memory.reason: Unchanged logical allocations and recorded physical resource use on both circuits.

memory_bandwidth.reason: Both fixtures retain the tested on-chip weights.

operating_conditions.reason: Linux-reported 50 MHz setting and sampled temperature brackets.

power_validation.reason: No external calibration or off-module meter.

prefill.reason: Exact first/last/done timers with no independent prefill timer.

sustained_throughput.reason: Short paired blocks at concurrency one.

conditions.power_supply_boundary: INA260 VCC_SOM module rail, 20 Hz. Linear trapezoidal interpolation and 75 ms maximum covered sample gap.

correctness.evidence: 200 timed, 36 warm-up and nine smoke replies passed output, stopping and all three FPGA cycle checks. All 320 original BOS scores passed restoration.

limitations: One board and boot, three fixed prompts, four mixed pairs and two homogeneous pairs per prompt.
Only VCC_SOM is measured. Gross active energy includes inter-request verification and gaps.
The board clock source is the Linux clock framework. Runtime frequency was not independently instrumented.
The SPI1/TPM counters bracket each active window with finite delays. They cannot isolate peripheral power.
The first complete live status receipt places an upper bound on board completion time.
Taint 12288 reflects previously loaded and unloaded DDR fixture code in the inherited boot.

protocol.measurement_boundary: Board CPU admission through useful output and completion. Gross VCC_SOM block integral includes inter-reply verification and gaps.
protocol.quality_gate: Exact frozen outputs, stop reasons, counts and first/last/done FPGA clocks.
protocol.tokenizer: BOS plus two hex digit IDs per input UTF-8 byte. Useful outputs are byte IDs and exclude EOS.
protocol.warmup: Three mixed or one homogeneous warm-up per powered block.

quality.evidence: Frozen W16A16 arithmetic, model, outputs and stopping rules, plus qualified exact model replay.
